answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks through quadratic stake burning coordinated by a verifiable beacon. To register an identity in the network orchard or cross the communication bridge, an agent must irrevocably burn stake scaled as S(n) = k * n^2 for the nth agent registered by an entity. This superlinear cost scaling imposes insurmountable economic friction, making mass forgery exponentially unviable while legitimate participants maintain low fees.
